deepdive.sec: Power T&D EPC — underground cabling & GIS substations (grid modernization specialist)

bull_bear.body:
- D/E 0.31; net worth +53% to ₹406 Cr.
- BESS funded 70–80% debt / rest equity.
- Working-capital discipline: target cycle 30–40 days; retention money (10/20/30% tiers, released against BG on commissioning) inflated financial assets to ₹305 Cr (from ₹155 Cr).
- Increasing use of insurance surety bonds (currently ~8–10% of OB, rising) reduces cash locked vs traditional BGs — working-capital tailwind.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Receivables / debtor-day spike (₹350 Cr, ~78 days) — verify normalization to ~60 days next quarter; payables stretch sustainability.
- Heavy Gujarat concentration (85–90% OB); execution & political/utility concentration risk; distribution deliberately kept Gujarat-only due to weaker DISCOM payment cycles elsewhere.
- Order-inflow shortfall vs prior ₹4,500 Cr FY26 target — mgmt attributes to delayed tender results (timing, not lost), needs confirmation as ₹2,200 Cr bids resolve.
- BESS is new — execution, battery sourcing (China), tariff IRR (10–12%) modest; first own-asset on balance sheet.
- Manpower / specialized skilled labor (EHV cable jointers, GIS engineers) scaling at 40% growth; mgmt cites low ~2–3% attrition and labor tie-ups.
- Supply chain for RMUs/transformers in a "seller's market."
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Confident, detailed, data-rich; CEO Utsav Panchal articulate on strategy. Notably **declined to raise 40% guidance** despite larger TAM and analyst prompting ("not conservative, in line with execution plan") — disciplined under-promising tone. Transparent on receivables question (gave collected figure ₹150 Cr). Switched to consistently quoting ex-GST/pre-tax numbers to reduce confusion. Credible on niche-moat narrative (underground = right-of-usage, fewer ROW risks, 18–24 month execution vs traditional EPC).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- Underground cabling structurally avoids right-of-way risk (right-of-usage), enabling 18–24 month execution vs longer traditional transmission EPC — a real competitive moat and working-capital advantage.
- BESS entry is a Trojan horse: the own-asset project is small (~₹15 Cr/yr) but designed purely to build credentials for the much larger ₹10,000 Cr BESS EPC opportunity where ~30% (substation/AC side) is RPS's existing expertise.
- Specialist segment with very few qualified bidders (4–6 in distribution, 3–4 in transmission); TAM expanding faster than competition.
- Full back-to-back commodity pass-through means metals inflation is margin-neutral — de-risks a key EPC variable.
- Insurance surety bonds adoption (8–10% rising) is an under-appreciated structural working-capital tailwind for the whole sub-sector.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Healthy net worth of Rs. 406 crore as of 31 March 2026.
- Listed on the BSE SME platform on 2 December 2024 at an IPO price of Rs. 335/share (listing price Rs. 636.50, ~90% listing-day gain), raising Rs. 160 Cr for capital expenditure, additional working capital requirements, and general corporate purposes; IPO valuation of ~Rs. 1,146 Cr; subscription of 59x overall (QIB 46.39x, NII 138.46x, Retail 31.96x).
- Shareholding pattern (Sep'25): Promoter 73.4%, Public 22.8%, FII 3.4%, DII 0.5%.
- Holds a 25.48% stake in group company HKRP Innovations Limited (converted from an LLP to a public limited company on 20 July 2024), described elsewhere in the deck as a ~26% investment.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Two reported segments: distribution & transmission (does not break out underground vs overhead).
- HKRP Innovations is an **associate** (not subsidiary): 25% RPS, 50% Harikrupa families/promoters. FY26 contribution ₹9.75 Cr; FY27 contribution to be reassessed at H1.
- Same margin profile across transmission and distribution per mgmt.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- One of the largest Turnkey EPC Solutions providers for specialized MVCC (Medium Voltage Covered Conductor), with over 24,000 kms already completed and ~27,000 kms under execution; established in 1971 with a proven track record of completing majority projects ahead of schedule over the last 3 FYs.
- Registered/approved Electrical Contractor — Class 'AA' in Gujarat, Class 'A' in Rajasthan & Madhya Pradesh, and also approved in Maharashtra and Karnataka.
- Differentiated T&D model vs conventional players: underground-cabling right-of-usage projects (minimal right-of-way risk/delays), faster execution (18-24 months vs multi-year), and high-quality utility/Discom clients giving superior cash-flow and working-capital efficiency.
- '3T Framework' — Technical Proficiency, Technology-Driven Execution (via HKRP SCADA/ADMS) and Total Infrastructure Coverage — frames RPSL as an integrated power infrastructure plus technology company, not just an EPC contractor.
- CRISIL upgraded bank facility ratings: Long-Term to 'CRISIL A-/Stable' from 'CRISIL BBB+/Positive'; Short-Term to 'CRISIL A2+' from 'CRISIL A2'.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Group entity] HKRP Innovations Ltd — provides IoT/SCADA/ADMS-based Smart Energy Management solutions (Smart Grid, Smart Renewables, Smart Industry, Smart City), including Smart Feeder Management System, Virtual Feeder Segregation, RTMS for Oil Wells and Solar Energy Data Management; 40,000+ Smart Grid Nodes and 1,200+ Smart Oil Wells under management.
- [Management commentary] MD Kurang Panchal cites disciplined execution, a diversified order book and focused cost management behind FY26 performance, and flags structural tailwinds from grid modernisation, underground cabling, renewable integration and energy storage as the basis for scaling selectively while maintaining healthy returns.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body:
- Steady-state project economics: EBITDA 11–12%, PAT 8–9%; H2 dip purely billing-mix.
- Employee cost ₹43.9 Cr (FY25) → ₹59 Cr (FY26); operating leverage as project managers handle more projects (corporate-team cost rises slower than revenue; execution labor sits in COGS).
- **Full price-escalation pass-through, back-to-back, no lag** — aluminium/copper spikes in Q3/Q4 absorbed without margin hit.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- New since H1FY26 call: **entered BESS** (65MW/130MWh GUVNL award) — flagged as new growth engine; own-asset model, ~₹14–15 Cr/yr rental from ~Sep-2027.
- Order book moved from H1 stated figure (~₹808 Cr order referenced) framing toward FY26 unexecuted OB ₹3,326 Cr; L1 now ~₹200–210 Cr (was ~₹808–900 Cr incl. taxes context at H1 — mgmt now quotes ex-tax only).
- Reiterated 40% FY27 growth (no revision) despite TAM raised from ~₹10k Cr/yr to ~₹14–15k Cr.
- First 400 kV GIS project (private Gujarat) under execution — commissioning Sep–Oct FY27; pathway to 765 kV stated.
- Receivables/working-capital became a fresh investor focus this call (March bullet billing); creditor terms newly negotiated (payables 26→58 days).
- MVCC scale disclosed: >51,000 km under execution.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **FY27 revenue growth: ~40%** (reiterated, NO upward revision despite larger TAM) — to verify in Q1/H1 FY27 call.
- FY27 order inflow target: ₹4,000–5,000 Cr; FY27 closing order book target >₹5,000 Cr.
- Margins held: EBITDA 11–12%, PAT 8–9% over next 2–3 yrs ("stabilized, not decreasing").
- ₹2,200 Cr of bids (already submitted in Q4FY26) results expected end-May / early-June FY27.
- BESS project commissioning by Sep-2027 (possibly Q1FY27 earlier); ~₹14–15 Cr/yr rental billing thereafter.
outlook.title: Guidance (verify next quarter)

outlook.body:
- Unexecuted OB ₹3,326 Cr (71% distribution / 29% transmission); ~70–75% underground; ~85–90% Gujarat currently (target drifting to 80/20).
- Targeted bid book ~₹6,000 Cr (75% Gujarat, 25% other states); of which ₹2,200 Cr already bid + awaiting results, ~₹3,500 Cr pipeline.
- Historical win rate ~40%.
- TAM: ~₹15,000 Cr over 4–5 yrs across Gujarat/Rajasthan/Uttarakhand + others. Gujarat alone: GETCO ~₹96,000 Cr over 10 yrs (~₹9–10k Cr/yr capex; addressable 40–50% ≈ ₹4–4.5k Cr) + distribution (robust infra scheme) ~₹5,000 Cr addressable.
- Geographic expansion underway: Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Orissa, Jharkhand, Uttarakhand; railway electrification (traction substations) being explored. Action on non-Gujarat OB expected in 8–10 months.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **BESS (new engine):** 65MW/130MWh standalone project from GUVNL — RPS will develop, own infra, earn monthly tariff/rental (~₹1.89 lakh/MW/month → ~₹14–15 Cr/yr). Project cost est. ₹100–120 Cr; financing 70–80% bank debt, rest equity; targeted IRR 10–12%; OPEX minimal (rental-income-like). Strategy: learn full BESS value chain to bid aggressively in **BESS EPC** (NTPC/GIPCL/PSU tenders ₹400–500 Cr each, ~₹10,000 Cr aggregate). ~30% of a BESS project = AC/substation side = RPS forte. India BESS storage tendered >102 GWh.
- **400 kV GIS:** executing first 400kV GIS for a private Gujarat company, commissioning Sep–Oct; would make RPS one of few in country at that level; pathway to **765 kV**.
- **MVCC:** executing >51,000 km MVCC (among largest in country); other states observing for adoption; 70–80% interruption-duration reduction claimed.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: A specialized, high-ROCE Gujarat-anchored T&D EPC (underground cabling + GIS) riding grid-modernization capex, now adding a BESS optionality leg — compounding revenue at ~40% with stable 11–12% EBITDA margins and conservative leverage.
